<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hero" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C42936"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.14"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="16" x2="330" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="16" x2="334" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="347" y1="13" x2="351" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="360" y="8" width="21" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="10" width="15" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="381" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="61" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="26,69 31,48 37,57 44,47 48,69 38,65 30,69" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="57" y="66" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">tinder</text>
  </g>
  <text x="319" y="65" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">RESTORE</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="89" x2="390" y2="89" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- back and title -->
  <polyline points="27,116 19,124 27,132" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="42" y="130" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Tinder Plus</text>
  <circle cx="358" cy="124" r="10" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <text x="358" y="129" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#939393">?</text>

  <!-- hero photo card -->
  <rect x="17" y="148" width="356" height="212" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="17" y="145" width="356" height="212" rx="18" fill="url(#hero)"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="190" r="30" fill="#FF7854" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="17,315 115,236 163,279 213,226 373,335 373,357 17,357" fill="#C42936" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="17,330 92,274 151,313 208,260 373,341 373,357 17,357" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.66"/>
    <circle cx="279" cy="190" r="9" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <polygon points="55,320 116,267 148,293 188,257 252,320" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.20"/>
    <rect x="17" y="145" width="356" height="212" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <text x="37" y="190" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">MAKE EVERY MOMENT COUNT</text>
    <text x="37" y="230" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Meet more people.</text>
    <text x="37" y="257" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Get more matches.</text>
    <rect x="37" y="292" width="116" height="31" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.94"/>
    <text x="95" y="312" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">TINDER PLUS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- subscription intro -->
  <text x="195" y="389" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">More control. More fun.</text>
  <text x="195" y="411" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="normal" fill="#939393">Unlock premium features and swipe your way.</text>

  <!-- features -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="17" y="430" width="356" height="132" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="35" y1="474" x2="355" y2="474" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="518" x2="355" y2="518" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="48" cy="452" r="14" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <polygon points="48,440 51,449 60,449 53,455 55,464 48,459 41,464 43,455 36,449 45,449" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="75" y="457" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Unlimited Likes</text>
  <text x="247" y="457" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Swipe freely</text>

  <circle cx="48" cy="496" r="14" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  <polyline points="43,496 48,491 54,496 49,501 43,496" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polyline points="50,489 55,494 50,499" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="75" y="501" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Rewind</text>
  <text x="247" y="501" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Undo a swipe</text>

  <circle cx="48" cy="540" r="14" fill="#4396F7"/>
  <polygon points="48,529 53,536 51,545 44,545 42,536" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="532" x2="48" y2="542" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="75" y="545" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Passport</text>
  <text x="247" y="545" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Change your location</text>

  <!-- plan selection -->
  <text x="20" y="591" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Choose your plan</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="604" width="170" height="55" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="631" r="8" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="631" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="55" y="627" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">12 months</text>
    <text x="55" y="646" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">$6.67 / month</text>
    <rect x="123" y="610" width="55" height="16" rx="8" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="150" y="622" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">BEST VALUE</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="604" width="171" height="55" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="221" cy="631" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="238" y="627" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">1 month</text>
    <text x="238" y="646" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">$24.99 / month</text>
  </g>

  <!-- purchase button -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="20" y="676" width="350" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">UPGRADE TO TINDER PLUS</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="740" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Recurring billing. Cancel anytime in Settings.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <polygon points="39,785 50,776 61,785 61,799 54,799 54,790 46,790 46,799 39,799" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="50" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="787" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="123,787 127,791 134,783" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="128" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="211" cy="784" r="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <ellipse cx="211" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="211" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="285" y="779" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="290,794 290,800 296,794" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="291" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="297" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="295" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Chats</text>
  </g>
</svg>
